```{r new IMC Rphenograph_500 heatmap}
load(project_path("Revision/Nan annotation/Data/IMC spe objects/New IMC/spe2025-12-17 umap.RData"))
sfe<-readRDS(project_path("Revision/Nan annotation/Data/Xenium sfe objects/Xenium sfe object/XeniumSfe_FibAnno_251104104458.rds"))

z<-list("glycolysis"=c(2,30,32,7,15,26),"TCA_cycle"=c(29,24,31,17),"Amino_Acid"=c(8),"Fatty_acid_synthesis"=c(36),
        "Fatty_acid_oxidation"=(34),"Pentose_Pathway"=12,"anabolic_signaling"=c(9),
        "catabolic_signaling"=c(21),"Oxidative_stress"=c(37),
        "hypoxia"=38,"Mitochondrial_biogenesis"=c(22,13,10))

spe$metfiblabel <- case_when(spe$Rphenograph_500=="1"~"Met_hi_Fib",
                             spe$Rphenograph_500=="2"~"Met_hi_Fib",
                             spe$Rphenograph_500=="3"~"Met_int_Fib")

markers_ordered <- names(spe)[do.call(c, z)]

rowData(spe)$use_channel_met_markers<-grepl("GLUT1|PKM2|CD98|p_mTOR|pNRF2|G6PD|mtTFA|LDHA|SDHA|pAMPK|PGC1a|OGDH|GAPDH|CS|HK1|ATP5A|PFKL1_PFKM|CPT1a|ACAC|NOX4|HIF1a", rownames(spe)) ## for new spe

celltype_mean <- aggregateAcrossCells(as(spe[rowData(spe)$use_channel_met_markers,], "SingleCellExperiment"),  
                                              ids = spe$"metfiblabel", 
                                              statistics = "mean", 
                                              use.assay.type = "zrescaled")

spe_test <- celltype_mean
spe_test$metfiblabel <- as.character(spe_test$metfiblabel)
dittoHeatmap(
  spe_test,
  assay = "zrescaled",
  genes = markers_ordered,
  cluster_cols = T,
  cluster_rows = F,
  #scale = "zscaled",
  heatmap.colors = c(viridis(50), rep("#FDE725FF", 1.5)),
  annot.by = c("metfiblabel", 'ncells')
)

dittoHeatmap(
  spe_test,
  assay = "zrescaled",
  genes = markers_ordered,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  heatmap.colors = viridis(100),
  annot.by = c("metfiblabel", "ncells"),
  scale = "none",
  breaks = seq(-1, 0.5, length.out = 101)
)


```

```{r data}
library(SpatialExperiment)
library(scater)
library(tidyverse)

spe2 <- spe

spe1 <- readRDS(project_path("Revision/Nan annotation/Data/IMC spe objects/spe_old.rds"))
#spe2 <- readRDS(project_path("external/spe_final_with_all_gates.rds"))
spe1$dataset <- 'orig_imc'
spe2$dataset <- 'postxenium_imc'


meta <- dplyr::full_join(
  dplyr::select(as.data.frame(spe1@colData), ObjectNumber, sample_id, cell_labels, celltype, dataset) %>%
    mutate(gates = dplyr::case_when(
      .$cell_labels == 'CD31+' ~ 'Endothelial',
      .$cell_labels == 'E-cad+' ~ 'Epithelial',
      .$cell_labels == 'CD45+' ~ 'Immune',
      .default = .$cell_labels)) %>%
    mutate(gates = ifelse(startsWith(.$celltype, 'CD45_CD68'), 'Macrophage', .$gates)),
  dplyr::select(as.data.frame(spe2@colData), ObjectNumber, sample_id, gates, dataset, metfiblabel) 
)
ch_used <- rowData(spe1)$use_channel_met_markers

expr <- cbind(assay(spe1, 'z-rescaled_new'), assay(spe2, 'zrescaled'))
counts <- cbind(assay(spe1, 'counts'), assay(spe2, 'counts'))
asinh <- cbind(assay(spe1, 'asinh'), assay(spe2, 'asinh'))

merged <- SingleCellExperiment(
  list(counts = counts, asinh = asinh, expr = expr),
  colData = meta,
  rowData = rowData(spe1)
)
set.seed(171025)
merged <- scater::runUMAP(merged, subset_row = ch_used, exprs_values = 'expr', name = 'umap',
                  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::MulticoreParam())

library(dittoSeq)

dittoDimPlot(merged, var = 'dataset', reduction.use = 'umap')
dittoDimPlot(merged, var = 'gates', reduction.use = 'umap')

```

# Seurat anchor-based label transfer

## Stromal

```{r stromal-seu, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
library(Seurat)
gate <- 'Stromal'

obj <- merged[,merged$dataset == 'orig_imc' & merged$gates == gate]

assay1 <- CreateAssay5Object(counts = assay(obj, 'counts'), data = assay(obj, 'asinh'))

ref <- CreateSeuratObject(
  assay1,
  meta.data = as.data.frame(obj@colData)
)

ref@assays$RNA$scale.data <- assay(obj, 'expr') %>% `rownames<-`(rownames(ref))
VariableFeatures(ref) <- rownames(ref)[ch_used]
# ref <- ScaleData(ref)
ref <- RunPCA(ref)
ElbowPlot(ref)

ref <- RunUMAP(ref,  dims = 1:20, return.model = TRUE)
  

DimPlot(ref, group.by = 'celltype', alpha = .3)

obj <- merged[,merged$dataset == 'postxenium_imc' & merged$gates == gate]

assay(obj, "z_scaled_new") <- t(apply(assay(obj, "asinh"), 1, function(x) (x - mean(x))/sd(x)))

assay2 <- CreateAssay5Object(counts = assay(obj, 'counts'), data = assay(obj, 'asinh'))

query <- CreateSeuratObject(
  assay2,
  meta.data = as.data.frame(obj@colData)
)
VariableFeatures(query) <- rownames(query)[ch_used]
query@assays$RNA$scale.data <- assay(obj, 'z_scaled_new') %>% `rownames<-`(rownames(ref))
query <- RunPCA(query)
ElbowPlot(query)

anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(reference = ref, query = query, dims = 1:20,
    reference.reduction  = "pca")
query <- MapQuery(anchorset = anchors, reference = ref, query = query, reference.dims = 1:20,
    refdata = list(celltype = "celltype"), reference.reduction = "pca", reduction.model = "umap")
p1 <- DimPlot(ref, group.by = 'celltype', alpha = .3)
p2 <- DimPlot(query, group.by = 'predicted.celltype', alpha = .3)
p3 <- DimPlot(query, group.by = 'metfiblabel', alpha = .3)
print(p1|p2|p3)


merged$predicted.celltype <- NA
pred <- setNames(query$predicted.celltype, colnames(query))
lab <- case_when(is.na(merged$predicted.celltype) ~ pred[colnames(merged)],
                 .default = merged$predicted.celltype)
merged$predicted.celltype <- lab

table(merged$predicted.celltype)
table(query$predicted.celltype,query$metfiblabel)

```


```{r IMC Rphenograph_500 transfer}
#load(project_path("external/spe2025-12-17 umap.RData"))

head(colnames(spe))
head(colData(sfe)$KEY)

unique(colData(spe)$metfiblabel)

# Create a lookup dataframe
df_map <- data.frame(
  KEY = colnames(spe),
  metfiblabel = spe$metfiblabel,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Align based on shared KEYs
idx <- match(colData(sfe)$KEY, df_map$KEY)

# Transfer the predicted.celltype column
colData(sfe)$metfiblabel <- df_map$metfiblabel[idx]
# Check a few transferred entries
head(colData(sfe)$metfiblabel)

# Count how many matches were successful
sum(!is.na(colData(sfe)$metfiblabel))
sum(is.na(colData(sfe)$metfiblabel))



```

```{r new IMC Rphenograph_500 sankey}

df2 <- as.data.frame(S4Vectors::as.data.frame(colData(sfe)))[, c("lv3_anno", "metfiblabel")]
df2 <- df2[!is.na(df2$lv3_anno) & !is.na(df2$metfiblabel) & df2$lv3_anno != "", ]

sankey3 <- ggsankey::make_long(df2, lv3_anno, metfiblabel)

ggplot(sankey3,
       aes(x = x, next_x = next_x,
           node = node, next_node = next_node,
           fill = node, label = node)) +
  geom_sankey(flow.alpha = 0.7, node.color = "grey30") +
  geom_sankey_label(size = 3, color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Sankey 3 – lv3_anno → Met State (met_hi / met_others only)",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))

matching <- as.data.frame(S4Vectors::as.data.frame(colData(sfe)))[, c("lv3_anno", "metfiblabel")]
matching <- df2[!is.na(df2$lv3_anno) & !is.na(df2$metfiblabel) & df2$lv3_anno != "", ]

# Summarize and calculate frequency
matching.summary <- matching %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(colnames(matching)))) %>%
  summarize(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(colnames(matching)[2]))) %>%
  mutate(tot_cells = sum(count), freq = count / tot_cells) %>%
  ungroup()

# Identify rare matches (freq < 0.1 or count < 20)
rare.matches <- matching.summary %>%
  filter(freq < 0.1 | count < 20) %>%
  select(all_of(colnames(matching[1:2])))

# Remove rare matches from the original data
matching.filtered <- matching %>%
  anti_join(rare.matches, by = colnames(matching)[1:2])

# Create sankey data with filtered matches
matching.sankey <- make_long(matching.filtered, !!sym(colnames(matching)[1]), !!sym(colnames(matching)[2]))

# Plot the simplified Sankey
ggplot(
  matching.sankey,
  aes(
    x = x,
    next_x = next_x,
    node = node,
    next_node = next_node,
    fill = factor(node),
    label = node
  )
) +
  geom_sankey(flow.alpha = 0.3, node.color = "gray30") +
  geom_sankey_label(size = 3,
                    color = "white",
                    fill = "gray40") +
  theme_sankey(base_size = 18) +
  labs(x = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))


```

# genes_use_subset <- c(

genes_use_subset <- unique(c(
  # your original set
  "CTHRC1","POSTN","FN1","COL1A1","COL1A2","COL8A1","SFRP4","SFRP2","FAP","LRRC15",
  "CCL19","CXCL12","APOE","PI16","LGR5","COL18A1","WIF1","ACTA2",

  # pan-fibro / “universal” fibroblasts (often used to define less-activated states)
  "DCN","LUM","DPT","CD34","PDGFRA",
  "COL15A1","COL14A1","C7","CFD","CLU","APOD","FBLN1","FBLN2","TNXB",

  # inflammatory fibroblasts (iCAF-like chemokine/cytokine programs)
  "IL6","IL11","CXCL1","CXCL8","CCL2","CCL20","IL1R1",

  # antigen-presenting fibroblasts (apCAFs; MHC-II module)
  "CD74","HLA-DRA","HLA-DRB1","HLA-DPA1","HLA-DPB1",

  # profibrotic / myofibroblast-like programs (ECM production, contractility, crosslinking)
  "CTGF","TGFBI","SERPINE1",
  "TAGLN","MYL9","CALD1","MYH11",
  "ITGA11","COL3A1","COL5A1","COL5A2","COL6A1","COL6A2","COL12A1","COL11A1",
  "SPARC","BGN","THBS1","TNC",
  "LOX","LOXL2",
  "MMP2","TIMP1",

  # matrix-remodeling CAF-like programs (often separate from pure myofibroblast markers)
  "MMP1","MMP3","MMP9"
))

genes_use_subset_selected <- unique(c(
  # your original set
  "FN1","COL8A1","SFRP4","CCL19","APOE","COL18A1","WIF1","ACTA2",
  
  # inflammatory fibroblasts (iCAF-like chemokine/cytokine programs)
  "IL6","IL11","CCL20","IL1R1",
  
  # profibrotic / myofibroblast-like programs (ECM production, contractility, crosslinking)
  "TNC",
  "LOX","LOXL2",
  "MMP2","TIMP1",

  # matrix-remodeling CAF-like programs (often separate from pure myofibroblast markers)
  "MMP9",

  # pan-fibro / “universal” fibroblasts (often used to define less-activated states)
  "DCN","LUM","DPT","CD34","PDGFRA",
  "COL14A1","FBLN2","TNXB", "PI16"
))

# Optional: if you want to explicitly flag pericyte-/mural-like clusters to exclude or separate
genes_pericyte_like <- c("RGS5","PDGFRB","CSPG4","MCAM","ABCC9","KCNJ8","NOTCH3")

stromal_types <- c("Met_int_Fib", "Met_hi_Fib")
cur_sfe <- sfe[, sfe$metfiblabel %in% stromal_types]


library(Seurat)

seurat_obj <- as.Seurat(
  cur_sfe,
  counts = "counts",
  data   = "logcounts"
)
unique(Idents(seurat_obj))
Idents(seurat_obj) <- "metfiblabel"

# ✅ enforce stromal_1 ... stromal_8 order
Idents(seurat_obj) <- as.factor(Idents(seurat_obj))#, levels = stromal_types)

## --- Prepare data: only stromal_2, stromal_4, stromal_8 ---

keep_stromal <- c("Met_int_Fib", "Met_hi_Fib")
#keep_stromal <- unique(seurat_obj$predicted.celltype)

# Idents(seurat_obj) <- factor(
#   seurat_obj$predicted.celltype,
#   levels = metfiblabel
# )
# 
 obj_sub <- subset(seurat_obj, idents = keep_stromal)


## --- Extract DotPlot data and manually row-scale gene expression ---

ddata1 <- DotPlot(obj_sub, features = genes_use_subset)$data
ddata2 <- DotPlot(obj_sub, features = genes_use_subset_selected)$data

library(dplyr)

# Row-wise scaling (per gene)
ddata1 <- ddata1 %>%
  group_by(features.plot) %>%
  mutate(avg.exp.scaled = base::scale(avg.exp)[,1]) %>%
  ungroup()

ddata2 <- ddata2 %>%
  group_by(features.plot) %>%
  mutate(avg.exp.scaled = base::scale(avg.exp)[,1]) %>%
  ungroup()

# Ensure x-axis = stromal clusters in correct order
ddata1$id <- factor(ddata1$id, levels = keep_stromal)
ddata2$id <- factor(ddata2$id, levels = keep_stromal)


## --- Final plot: x = clusters, y = genes ---

p1 <- ggplot(ddata1, aes(x = id, y = features.plot)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = pct.exp, color = avg.exp.scaled)) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(7, "RdBu"))) +
  scale_size(range = c(1, 8)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )

p2 <- ggplot(ddata2, aes(x = id, y = features.plot)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = pct.exp, color = avg.exp.scaled)) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(7, "RdBu"))) +
  scale_size(range = c(1, 8)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )

p1
